Hopefully we can get some breathing room soon for our non-event-related projects. But meanwhile, here are the latest event reports:

== Closing Blessing ==
We came together to do the work. We came to do the work together. This work is meant to raise our spirits, connect us with our highest aspirations, and weave us feeling comforted and connected together. I hope that the strain of our growing pains is not too overwhelming for us. May your week be filled with life and love, family, friends, and a sense that life has purpose.  -- Blessed Be
